verdict.rationale: skills.sh ships a fully documented official CLI (`npx skills`) with rich subcommands—add, use, list, search, update, remove, init, experimental_install/sync—supporting multiple agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.), symlink-based installs, CI/CD-friendly non-interactive mode, and private/public repo auth, all corroborated by first-party GitHub docs and independent HN discussion of real usage. Missing for 10: deeper independent hands-on verification of update/version-pinning reliability (one community comment questioned documentation of these, though the CLI docs do cover them) and no REST API alternative.
